question.:question/problem:
Without using a calculator, find the exact value of

$$
\frac{\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)}{\sec\left(165^{\circ}\right)}
$$

$$
\frac{\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)}{\sec\left(165^{\circ}\right)}=
$$
{{value}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
Rewrite the reciprocal denominator to expose a sine–cosine product.

Set $x=165^{\circ}$.

$$
\frac{\sin\left(x\right)}{\sec\left(x\right)}=\sin\left(x\right)\cdot\frac{1}{\sec\left(x\right)}=\sin x\cos x
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}2\sin x\cos x &=\sin(2x) \\ &=\sin\left(330^{\circ}\right) \\ &=- \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Substitute this exact value:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)}{\sec\left(165^{\circ}\right)}&=\frac{1}{2}\left(- \frac{1}{2}\right) \\ &=- \frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: Real constant angle; both sine and cosine are nonzero.
